title: Orca: the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents
description:
Orca is a desktop workspace for running several coding agents side by side, with each task isolated in its own Git worktree. You can fan one prompt across five agents, compare their changes, annotate diffs, and merge the result you trust. A mobile companion lets you monitor jobs and send follow-ups, while SSH worktrees move execution to a remote machine.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/stablyai/orca
